title: Gold Plus Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document lists credit card APY bonuses for Gold Plus Account holders at Rho-Bank and explains that bonuses are automatically applied when you hold both an eligible credit card and a Gold Plus Account under the same customer profile. It provides APY bonus rates for Bronze, Silver, Gold Rewards, Platinum, Diamond Elite, EcoCard, Green Rewards, and Crypto-Cash Back cards (+0.05% to +0.35%).
